dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いいたします。設定などでリクエストありますか？)
dialogue.English: (My pleasure. Do you have any requests for the scenario?)

dialogue.content: 初めてですので、わかりません、、、このままで大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: This is my first time, so I'm not sure… It's fine to proceed as is.

dialogue.content: (はい了解です！)
dialogue.English: (Okay, got it!)

dialogue.content: j時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We'll get started when it's time, okay?

dialogue.content: (はいお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Yes, please.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。よろしければ、年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 16歳　女子です
dialogue.English: I'm a 16-year-old girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 部活やめようか悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about quitting my club.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 部活で何かあったか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what has been happening in your club?

dialogue.content: 努力してもうまくならなくて辛いです
dialogue.English: It's painful because I'm not getting any better, no matter how hard I try.

dialogue.content: そうんんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 因みに何の部活に入っているのでしょう？
dialogue.English: By the way, what club are you in?

dialogue.content: バスケです
dialogue.English: Basketball.

dialogue.content: バスケ、激しいスポーツですね
dialogue.English: Basketball, that's an intense sport, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically?

dialogue.content: 例えば、ドリブルとか？
dialogue.English: For example, dribbling, or something like that?

dialogue.content: 後輩が入ってきたんだけど、みんな上手で、追い抜かされそうです
dialogue.English: The juniors have joined, and they're all really good; it feels like they're going to surpass me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: あなたのことは何と呼んでよいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I call you?

dialogue.content: のんです
dialogue.English: Non.

dialogue.content: のんさん
dialogue.English: Non.

dialogue.content: 自分が上手くならないと、不安があるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel anxious about not improving?

dialogue.content: メンバーに入れないです
dialogue.English: I won't be able to make the team.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 試合のメンバーに入れなくて、悲しかったんですね
dialogue.English: It must have been sad not making the team for the games.

dialogue.content: まだメンバーには入ってますが、このままだと落とされる
dialogue.English: I'm still on the roster for now, but at this rate, I'll be dropped.

dialogue.content: 一生懸命に練習しているのに、焦りもありそうですか？
dialogue.English: Even though you're practicing so hard, it sounds like you're also feeling anxious?

dialogue.content: 焦ってます。すごく
dialogue.English: I am anxious. Very.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でももう無理かも
dialogue.English: But it might be impossible for me now.

dialogue.content: 高校二年生？
dialogue.English: Are you a second-year in high school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: じゃあ、来年の今頃までで引退かな？
dialogue.English: So, you'll be retiring around this time next year, right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 何とかメンバーに入りたいですね
dialogue.English: You really want to stay on the roster somehow, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい、落ちたくないです
dialogue.English: Yes, I don’t want to be dropped.

dialogue.content: せっかく今まで頑張ってきたんですもの
dialogue.English: After all, you've worked so hard up until now.

dialogue.content: 自分なりにできるだけのことはしてきたんですが、もうダメかもしれません
dialogue.English: I’ve done everything I could in my own way, but it might be no use anymore.

dialogue.content: 諦めてやめたほうがいいのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if I should just give up and quit.

dialogue.content: 後輩のほうが上手く思えるのは、どんなことからでしょう？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that the underclassmen are better?

dialogue.content: 思うだけじゃなくて、確実に技術もあるし、優れています
dialogue.English: It’s not just a feeling—they definitely have the skills and are better.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今は、部活をやっていて、楽しくプレイできていないんですね
dialogue.English: So right now, you're not able to enjoy playing in your club activities, are you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。追い込まれてる感じです
dialogue.English: That's right. I feel like I'm being cornered.

dialogue.content: プレッシャーもあるし
dialogue.English: And there's pressure, too.

dialogue.content: それは苦しいですね
dialogue.English: That must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先輩になって思うプレッシャーですね
dialogue.English: It’s the pressure you feel as an upperclassman, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: 一年生のころは楽しんでできましたか？
dialogue.English: Back when you were a first-year, were you able to enjoy it?

dialogue.content: そうですね。先輩に憧れて頑張ってました
dialogue.English: Yes. I looked up to my seniors and did my best.

dialogue.content: 今より楽しくやってたと思います
dialogue.English: I think I was having more fun than I am now.

dialogue.content: でも今もバスケは好きなんです
dialogue.English: But I still love basketball.

dialogue.content: でももう無理かも
dialogue.English: But it might be impossible now.

dialogue.content: 二年生になって、後輩が入ると焦りを感じる、
dialogue.English: So, when you became a second-year and the younger students joined, you started to feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 二年生は何人くらいいるのですか？
dialogue.English: About how many second-years are there?

dialogue.content: 15人です
dialogue.English: There are 15 of us.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: このことを、部活の子に相談したことは？
dialogue.English: Have you talked about this with your teammates?

dialogue.content: あります
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: その時はなんて言ってました？
dialogue.English: What did they say at the time?

dialogue.content: でも、頑張るしかないよって言われました
dialogue.English: I was told that I just have to keep trying my best.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、大好きでとっても頑張っていますよね
dialogue.English: But you love it, and you're trying very hard, aren't you?

dialogue.content: はい、やれるだけのことはやってるつもりです
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel like I’m doing everything I can.

dialogue.content: メンバーに入れるか、とても気になると思います
dialogue.English: I imagine you’re very concerned about whether you’ll make the roster.

dialogue.content: そのことで、頭がいっぱいになってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It must be taking up all your thoughts, right?

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: だから、大好きなバスケをやっていても楽しめない
dialogue.English: That's why you can't enjoy playing the basketball you love so much.

dialogue.content: いっそのこと、やめてしまおうかと悩んでいる。そんなきもちですかね
dialogue.English: And you're wondering if you should just quit altogether. Is that how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気持ちを教えてくれて、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your feelings with me.

dialogue.content: 楽しくプレイしたいですもんね
dialogue.English: You want to be able to enjoy playing, right?

dialogue.content: 仮の話ですが、他に気になる部活はあるんですか？
dialogue.English: This is just hypothetical, but are there any other clubs you're interested in?

dialogue.content: そうですね...でも頑張ってもダメなものはダメなのかなって、
dialogue.English: Well... I'm starting to think that if something isn't working out, it just won't, no matter how hard I try.

dialogue.content: 自分はダメだなって思います
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm no good.

dialogue.content: そんなことはないと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I don't think that's true at all.

dialogue.content: まだわからないですからね
dialogue.English: We don't know for sure yet.

dialogue.content: 私だけじゃなくて、みんな頑張ってるのに、自分は全然上達しないし
dialogue.English: It’s not just me—everyone is working hard, but I’m not improving at all.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: もう自分が嫌になります
dialogue.English: I’m starting to hate myself.

dialogue.content: そんな風に感じているんですね
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 去年の自分と比べて、プレイはどうですか？
dialogue.English: How is your play compared to last year?

dialogue.content: あまり上達してないです
dialogue.English: I haven’t improved much.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: だからダメなんです
dialogue.English: That’s why I’m no good.

dialogue.content: 自信がないのですね
dialogue.English: You’re feeling like you lack confidence.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 分かります、私も学生時代そうでしたよ
dialogue.English: I understand. I was like that when I was a student, too.

dialogue.content: 上達って、自分ではわかりにくいですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to notice your own improvement, isn't it?

dialogue.content: だからずっと変わらないように感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That's why it can feel like you're not changing at all.

dialogue.content: もし、メンバーに入れなかったら、バスケはもうやりたくない？
dialogue.English: If you don't make the team, will you not want to play basketball anymore?

dialogue.content: 屈辱です。バスケ推薦で入ったのに、落ちたらもう無理かも
dialogue.English: It would be humiliating. I got into this school on a basketball scholarship, so if I get dropped, I don't think I can handle it.

dialogue.content: 親にも言えない
dialogue.English: I can't tell my parents, either.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 親は何ていうと思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think your parents would say?

dialogue.content: 恥だって言うと思う
dialogue.English: I think they’d say it’s shameful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: このことは、ご両親に相談しにくい？
dialogue.English: Is it hard to talk to your parents about this?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: おそらく、こんなに頑張ってきたことを一番応援しているのは、ごだと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine the people who are cheering you on the most for all your hard work are...

dialogue.content: ご両親ですね
dialogue.English: ...your parents.

dialogue.content: メンバーに関係なく応援してくださっているのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: They are probably supporting you regardless of whether you’re on the roster, don’t you think?

dialogue.content: 応援はしてるけど、頑張るのは当たり前だと思っています。
dialogue.English: They do support me, but they think working hard is just expected.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: メンバーも気になりますが、楽しくしたいですよね
dialogue.English: You’re concerned about the roster, but you also want to enjoy it, right?

dialogue.content: 今、他に楽しめることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you enjoy doing right now?

dialogue.content: ありません
dialogue.English: No, there isn't.

dialogue.content: もし部活をやめたとして、楽しめる部活はある？
dialogue.English: If you were to quit this club, is there another club you could enjoy?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No, there isn't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: プレッシャーの中、一生懸命に頑張ってきましたよね
dialogue.English: You've been working so hard under all this pressure, haven't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やっぱりバスケ以外は考えられないように感じます。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you really can’t imagine anything other than basketball.

dialogue.content: 本当にバスケが大好きで、でも今は苦しい時期で
dialogue.English: You truly love basketball, but right now is a difficult time for you.

dialogue.content: もし、メンバーになれなかったらと、不安も感じながら、悩んで、そういったことも含めて、上達の一歩なのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Worrying about what might happen if you don't make the team, feeling anxious... all of that might be a step toward improvement.

dialogue.content: 今は、本当に辛くて、苦しくて、でも確実に成長していると思います
dialogue.English: Right now, it's truly painful and difficult, but I believe you are definitely growing.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間で、今日はお話を聞くだけになってしまいましたが、今のお気持ちはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It's almost time to finish. I ended up just listening to you today, but how are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 聞いていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: もし何かありましたら、いつでもお話伺いますので、いつでも来てくださいね
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, I'm always here to listen, so please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （お付き合いいただきありがとうございました。不慣れですみませんでした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for bearing with me. I’m sorry I’m not very experienced.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work.)
